name: inl_p
description: inl_p performs a 32-bit input operation from the specified I/O port and pauses until the I/O completes. It is used for low-level hardware access and is primarily intended for internal kernel use, though accessible from user space with proper permissions.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The I/O port number to read from.

return_value.success: Returns the unsigned int value read from the port
return_value.failure: May cause a segmentation fault if the process lacks permission to access the port

bugs: These functions must be compiled with optimization enabled (e.g., -O or -O2), otherwise they will cause unresolved references at link time. They are hardware-specific and may behave differently on various systems.
